title: Unidentified items
summary: The DM can award or mark an item as unidentified. Players see the name, description and value the DM gives it until the DM, or a sage, identifies it.
items: Unidentified items show an Unidentified tag, and “unknown value” when the DM set no value.
Inventories, character sheets, Activity, receipts, past sessions and the player display show only what players are told.
An unidentified item sells at the value players see; one with an unknown value can't be sold until the DM sets a value or identifies it.
Identifying an item is recorded once in Activity, and a sage's Identify reveals the item when the DM answers.
